resources.name: Workflow Rules & Best Practices
resources.description: CRITICAL: Mandatory workflow rules for all C64 programming

resources.name: Fast Path Workflows
resources.description: Shortest reliable workflows for common C64U and VICE tasks, including dual-backend demos.

resources.name: Game Development Index (read first)
resources.description: CRITICAL: Read first when asked to write, port or extend a C64 game; chooses modern C64U/Ultimate (default) or stock C64 and lists which resources to read by game type.

resources.name: Game Architecture
resources.description: Read before choosing addresses, VIC bank, loader or IRQ layout for a C64 game (stock C64 and modern Ultimate): frame loop, state machine, cycle budgets and memory-map templates.

resources.name: Game Techniques
resources.description: Read when implementing raster IRQs, sprite multiplexing, scrolling, collision, joystick input, music/SFX (also several SIDs), random numbers, PAL/NTSC handling or Ultimate start-up checks (turbo probe) in a C64 game (stock C64 and modern Ultimate).

resources.name: Game Toolchain
resources.description: Read when setting up a C64 game project, choosing an assembler or compiler, building PRG/D64/CRT files, or testing on VICE and hardware through c64bridge (stock C64 and modern Ultimate).

resources.name: Game References
resources.description: Read to find real games and projects to learn from, with the technique each is known for and where to read it: modern Ultimate (UCI, REU, Upic, turbo) projects and classic stock C64 games.

resources.name: Ultimate Hardware Features
resources.description: Read for modern C64U/Ultimate 64 features (CPU turbo via D031, multiple SIDs, video, config, detection); not applicable to a stock C64.

resources.name: Ultimate Command Interface (UCI)
resources.description: Read when a modern C64U/Ultimate game must load files from the Ultimate, save data, use the network, change the palette or detect the device via the UCI registers at DF1B; not on a stock C64.

resources.name: Ultimate REU
resources.description: Read when a modern C64U/Ultimate game streams or stores data in the REU (registers DF00, DMA, preload, sizes); not on a stock C64 unless a real REU is fitted.

resources.name: Ultimate Upic Graphics
resources.description: Read when a request mentions Upic or a 384x256 16-colour attribute-free full-screen game on a modern C64U/Ultimate at turbo speed; not for a stock C64.

resources.name: Ultimate Multi-SID Control
resources.description: Read when a modern C64U/Ultimate game uses more than one SID, sets SID addresses, range splits, pan or the mixer at run time, or must work with empty sockets, one or two real SIDs or SID replacements; not on a stock C64.

resources.name: Ultimate Turbo Benchmark
resources.description: Read when you need to measure CPU cycles per frame, badline or sprite cost, REU DMA speed or the reset 1 MHz window on a modern C64U/Ultimate, or to rerun the published measurements.

resources.name: Skill: assembly-program
resources.description: Use when the user wants a custom 6502/6510 assembly routine assembled, run and verified on the C64 (raster, sprites, IRQs, SID or VIC code written in assembly).

resources.name: Skill: basic-program
resources.description: Use when the user wants a custom Commodore BASIC v2 program written, uploaded and run, including output checks and BASIC listing or debugging.

resources.name: Skill: cross-platform-demo
resources.description: Use when the user wants a quick visible greeting or smoke test on VICE and/or C64U with screenshot or text verification.

resources.name: Skill: drive-manager
resources.description: Use when the user wants to mount, unmount, create, copy or inspect disk images or drive state (D64, D71, D81, drive slots, drive power).

resources.name: Skill: game-development
resources.description: Use when the user wants to design or build a Commodore 64 game, targeting a modern C64U/Ultimate device (default) or a stock C64; read first for any game request.

resources.name: Skill: graphics-demo
resources.description: Use when the user wants PETSCII art, sprites, bitmap or character-set graphics created, or a frame captured from the C64 or VICE.

resources.name: Skill: hello-world
resources.description: Use when the user asks for the fastest hello-world, greeting or smoke test, for example 'print HELLO WORLD on VICE' or 'run this on hardware'.

resources.name: Skill: memory-debug
resources.description: Use when the user wants to read, search, compare, patch, disassemble or save C64 memory, read the screen, or wait for on-screen text.

resources.name: Skill: printer-job
resources.description: Use when the user wants to print text or bitmaps, or define custom characters, on a Commodore (MPS) or Epson printer from a C64U or U2.

resources.name: Skill: sid-music
resources.description: Use when the user wants SID music or sound effects, such as playing a preset, composing or generating a tune, setting SID registers, or capturing and analyzing audio.

resources.name: Skill: software-launch
resources.description: Use when the user wants to run existing C64 software (a PRG, CRT cartridge or disk image) rather than a newly written program.

resources.name: Skill: stream-control
resources.description: Use when the user wants to start or stop a live video, audio or debug stream from an Ultimate 64-class device to another host.

resources.name: Skill: system-control
resources.description: Use when the user wants to pause, resume, reset, reboot or power off the machine, manage background tasks, or read or change Ultimate configuration.

resources.name: Active Platform Status
resources.description: Reports the active MCP platform and tool compatibility snapshot.
